Scheme.Description: Builds a Highest/Lowest midpoint channel from finished BTCUSDT five-minute candles, takes exact midpoint crosses after a 200-bar cooldown with one-step market reversals, requires a live TONUSDT depth feed, and uses unrealized P&L thresholds to cancel orders and flatten BTC exposure with explicit opposite market orders once per position.
